simple.meaning: בָּכָה (bâkâh) appears 116 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 14 more, beginning at Genesis 21:16. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, death, land.
